keyPhrases.text: This new staging of the classic...is fantastic
Anne Teresa De Keersmaeker's powerful new choreography
Jan Versweyveld's stunning minimal scenic and lighting design
achieves a new level of genius
If we're being honest, West Side Story has seemed a little out of date for quite a while
At times the images can be overwhelming and it's confusing where to focus

reasoning: Strong positive review with enthusiastic praise ('brilliantly,' 'fantastic,' 'genius') and clear recommendation. Minor criticisms about visual overwhelm don't diminish overall enthusiasm. Falls in 4/5 star range due to high praise with some reservations.
